description: This file is a shell script implementing 'git filter-branch' functionality, used to rewrite revision history in a git repository, applying various filters to commits, trees, tags, and references.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a commit or object ID to its rewritten counterpart using stored mappings.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips specified commits during rewriting by mapping parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit only if the tree differs from the empty tree, or takes an existing object.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and terminates the script.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Sets author and committer identity based on commit info.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Completes the identity setup and exports environment variables.
